headline: WSN @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.70 at ATL 6.12, with a projected total of 10.82. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: WSN moved +0.59 runs while ATL moved +1.64, changing the projected margin by -1.05 runs. The projected total climbed +2.23, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +13.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Martín Pérez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Daylen Lile, James Wood, Michael Harris II, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Mateo, José Tena because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
